component.name: VLC 4 Beta
component.summary: Development builds of the VLC multimedia player

description.p: Play local audio and video files and network streams with the VLC 4 development interface.

This community package downloads unmodified daily builds from the VideoLAN master-daily PPA for Ubuntu 26.10, with Ubuntu Qt and multimedia support libraries. This is an automated testing build; it may contain regressions and is not a stable release. The PPA is not maintained or supported by VideoLAN developers. Flathub offers the stable VLC release.
This package provides playback without a media library. In X11 sessions, video playback opens a separate window.

Music and Videos folders are available by default. Allow another media folder with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/media:ro org.videolan.VLCBeta. Undo custom permissions with flatpak override --user --reset org.videolan.VLCBeta.
For a desktop with a StatusNotifier tray, opt in with flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher --own-name=org.kde.* org.videolan.VLCBeta.
Opt into optical discs or capture devices with flatpak override --user --device=all org.videolan.VLCBeta.
